root_cause: The modal's focus management (_enforceFocus) only traps focus via focusin event but does not handle keyboard wrap-around for Shift+Tab on the first focusable element or Tab on the last focusable element.
repair_strategy: Add a keydown event listener on the modal element that intercepts Tab key presses, detects when focus is on the first/last focusable element in the dialog, and manually moves focus to the last/first element respectively with preventDefault.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now navigate backwards (Shift+Tab) from the first control (Close button) to the last control (Delete button) in the delete confirmation modal, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Low - the change only adds a keydown handler for Tab key when modal is shown, with proper cleanup via existing namespaced event disposal in BaseComponent.dispose().
verification_requirements: Run the frozen journey test "Move backwards through the delete confirmation" which presses Shift+Tab from #confirm-close and expects focus on #confirm-delete.
